name: wokarasu
description: 嗄らす only follows を particle

name: mononi
description: ものに not after も

name: nohayamete
description: early(速めて) not after の

name: tsu-iru
description: いる not after counter つ (avoids つ+いる misparse)

name: dekiru
description: 来てる/来る not after 出/で or 出/しゅつ (suppresses 出-来る spurious parse)

name: aux-verb-someru
description: 初める (aux-v 'begin to') only follows a masu-stem/ren'youkei base

name: n-after-particle
description: ん / んだ / のだ not after a noun-attaching particle (は/が/に/で/へ/だけ/ごろ/まで/も/など/には/の/のみ/を/さえ/でさえ/すら/と/とか/として/とは/や/にとって)

name: honorific
description: 君 (honorific suffix) not after a noun-attaching particle — otherwise it'd be mis-parsed as the name 'kun'

name: toomou
description: 思う / 言う not after 何だと (forces the と particle to split off as a separate segment before these verbs)

name: sae
description: reject right-segment starting with え after a left ending in さえ (prevents さえ+え-prefix mis-split)

name: roku
description: reject right-segment starting with く after a left ending in いろ (prevents 色-く mis-split, e.g. 色々)

name: janai
description: reject ない/ある/ん after a compound whose last piece is は (e.g. ではない). Only fires on compound words (splits.json entries); single-segment は is NOT rejected — Ichiran's filter-is-compound-end requires listp seq

name: dashi
description: reject する (and its conjugations) after a compound whose component-seq set contains だ (2089020) but NOT で (2028980). Implements Ichiran segfilter-dashi via the new compound-seq-set infrastructure: the filter only bites on true compounds (splits.json entries) — single-segment だ is unaffected. Activates when Phase 1c-seq synthesises compounds whose piece-wordId set tracks Ichiran semantics.

name: badend
description: unconditionally reject compounds whose last piece text matches these endings — prevents spurious compound-edge mis-parses. Only fires on compound words (splits.json entries); non-compound い-adjectives etc. are unaffected

name: sukiyoki
description: reject any segment ending in 好き that was reached via adj-literary (き-form of adj-i) conjugation — kills the 好い/好き misparse where adj-ix 好い's き-form collides with adj-na 好き. Ichiran def-segfilter-must-follow segfilter-sukiyoki with left-filter (constantly nil).

name: totte
description: reject って/て particle (2086960) after と particle (1008490) — prevents spurious と+って splits. Ichiran complement + filter-in-seq-set, :allow-first t.
